name: cdm/product/template/OptionFeature
description: Defines additional optional features that can be included in an option contract.

averagingFeature.description: Defines an option feature in which an average market observation price is determined on valuation and compared to the strike to determine a settlement amount.

fxFeature.description: Describes a quanto or composite FX feature.

knock.description: Specifies a knock in or knock out feature.

passThrough.description: Specifies the rules for pass-through payments from the underlier, such as dividends.
